description: Search p99 per 30 s window at 20 searches/s, each write run alone from an idle, indexed collection, as a multiple of that run's own no-writes control p99 (29.5 and 30.9 ms). x: minutes since the writes stopped. Line: mean of the two runs; band: their range. Stage 0: the no-writes control, mean and range, measured the same way (dimmed from stage 2). Stage 1: the small writes (1% price update, 1% full-row upsert, 1% delete, 10 min trickle at 5 rows/s), one colour each with a legend, no band. Stage 2: the small writes and their legend fade out; the 10% storm (teal) and the span headers come in. Stage 3: a 1% price update then a flush (berry); headers fade out. Source: vector_search_ecom results/b4d_single_ops.json, both repeats.

text.value: all four: latency variability within no-writes run ranges
thin: 30 s p99, mean of two runs. shaded: their range
